newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan JGC seen posting loss in 97/98-paper.
newsitem.headline: Japan JGC seen posting loss in 97/98-paper.

text.p: Japan's JGC Corp is expected to post a parent current loss of about seven billion yen for the year to March 31, 1998, marking the company's second year of losses in a row, a Japanese business daily said on Tuesday.
The Nihon Keizai Shimbun said the plant engineering firm's losses were due to projects with low profit margins and a rise in labour costs for the projects.
The daily also said the company's operating loss for 1997/98 could amount to about six billion yen due to some unprofitable projects.
JGC declined to comment on the report, saying that the company's earnings forecasts were not yet finalised.
A JGC spokesman said that the company would announce its 1996/97 results and its 1997/98 forecast on May 20.
